decision: Do not generate Port Hanshan from these views. No adequate broad environment screenshot was established in this short follow-up.
reference_standard: A real game view wide enough to identify the chosen area, its major walls/windows, ground layout, proportions and materials. Maps, planet illustration, dialogue or narrow corridor shots alone do not qualify.

new_images_examined.finding: Port Hanshan Plaza map and elevator location. Establishes layout only, not materials, elevations or broad architectural appearance.
Shows Lorik at a table, slanted windows and wall panels. Useful for local materials, but too tight to establish a complete wide arena or plaza.
Windowed corridor with a doorway. A narrow directional view, not the requested broad Port Hanshan plaza.
Noveria planet screen with a small illustrated location inset. It is not a navigable environment screenshot and cannot establish the plaza.

search_scope: Short follow-up to lot03 research, prioritizing new actual screenshot candidates on Gamepur and Shamus Young.
prior_unproductive_sources_note: Earlier SuperSoluce retrieval failed; prior GamePressure/GamerGuides views were tight dialogue shots. Fandom and TrueAchievements returned 402 and were not bypassed.
game_version_caution: Gamepur article is explicitly about Legendary Edition; Shamus Young retrospective shows original-era Mass Effect screenshots. No mixed-version visual source was used to generate an asset.
next_reference_needed: A broad in-game shot of Port Hanshan plaza, or a deliberately selected named sub-area with enough unobscured architecture to support a separate stage.
